$comment: The film registry. scripts/lib/films.mjs checks it and writes every film's pages (web/f/<slug>/) and the home page from web/templates/; scripts/contract.mjs expands contract.yaml's films block from it. A live film is served and checked in full. A film in production (status in_production) is listed on the home page by title, dates and status only: no page, no media, no synopsis. A paused film is taken off this file. A caption track is offered only once its review is 'reviewed'. screenplay_path (optional): where the film's working screenplay lives on the render machine (~ is the home folder), so the engine's bed-reuse lint (GRAMMAR A29 refined) can refuse a score another film already plays; DOCUMENT_FILMS overrides it. balance_fallback: only the Partition pilot, whose live sources.json predates the balance block, may show its own figures without declaring one.

films.title: Not a Free Agent
films.logline: the line, the roads, and the women both governments set out to recover
films.synopsis: In December 1947 the governments of India and Pakistan agreed to recover the women abducted in the violence of Partition, and recorded that the women's own wishes were irrelevant. A narrator follows the record from Noakhali in 1946 to the agreement of April 1950: the conferences, the camps, the ordinance and the December 1949 debate, in the words of the members who argued it, women among them.
films.content_note: It tells of killing, abduction and flight.
films.shows: This film shows no bodies or killing.

related.name: The Partition of India, in sound
related.line: Listen to void history's audio documentary on the Partition of India
related.where: On void history, part of the void family.

films.title: The Next Village
films.logline: a goddess, a needle, and a search from house to house
films.synopsis: In the villages of Bihar the disease was called by the goddess's name: Sitala. Among the Yoruba it belonged to the god of the earth. From 1966, searchers went from house to house and from village to village to find every case of smallpox. A narrator tells it in the words of the time, with readings from the record: the goddess and the god, the ring around each case, the farewell in Bihar, the last known cases, and the two years of looking that followed.
films.content_note: It shows people ill with smallpox, children among them.
films.shows: This film shows people with smallpox in photographs and medical films of the time.

films.title: Real World
films.logline: one day, as it was heard by the people working the sky and the city below
films.synopsis: On 11 September 2001, controllers at Boston and New York and the air defence sector tried to understand what was happening in the air. The film keeps to what was known that day, hour by hour: the tapes of the control rooms and the defence sector in the morning, and what was said and reported in public as the day went on. A narrator gives the time, the place and what was reported; the recordings carry the rest.
films.content_note: It concerns the attacks of 11 September 2001. It plays air traffic and air defence recordings made that day.
films.shows: This film shows the day as it was broadcast and photographed: the burning towers, the second impact, the Pentagon security camera's view of the impact, and the dust after the collapses, in wide views. It never shows an identifiable person in their final moments; a wide view is never zoomed in, slowed or held on a person; no final call is played; the dead are shown by what the day left empty.
